description: Cite-or-abstain ledger for the ZON (solar field) NormCard corpus. Evidence items that failed the verification gate are listed under rejectedEvidence (none in the zon shard: all 5 records were verified against the consolidated CVDR704250 text). Topics for which NO provincial norm could be cited for the zonneveld object type are recorded under abstentions — these must never appear as NormCards or FormalRules until a verified citation exists.
policy: cite-or-abstain: a legal claim becomes a NormCard only with instrument + article + version/date + verbatim quote + URL, all verified. Everything else is recorded here with a reason.

abstentions.reason: The Omgevingsverordening provincie Utrecht contains no provincial nitrogen articles (verified in the wind recon, A-01); nitrogen rules are national law. National instruments were not fetched in this recon run, so no citation exists for the zon track either — abstained.
abstentions.wouldHaveBeen: exclusion/assessment rule for nitrogen deposition near Natura 2000

abstentions.topic: national rules for zonnevelden (Besluit activiteiten leefomgeving / Bouwbesluit / grid-connection law)
abstentions.reason: National instruments governing solar-field construction, safety and grid connection were outside the corpus scope (provincial verordening + visie only); no citation exists — abstained.

abstentions.topic: energy test / grid connection capacity (aansluitbaarheid) for zonnevelden
abstentions.reason: Afdeling 5.3 (art. 5.10/5.11) exists in the verordening and applies to new energy functions generally, but the zon shard carries no verified card for it and the check depends on grid-capacity data outside the corpus — abstained for this track rather than guessed.
abstentions.wouldHaveBeen: procedural condition rule on grid capacity

abstentions.topic: rooftop, facade and infrastructure-mounted solar panels
abstentions.reason: The Bijlage I definition (NC-Z-01) explicitly excludes roofs of buildings from the zonneveld object type; rooftop/facade solar is governed by national and municipal building law, not by provincial verordeningsnormen — no provincial citation exists, abstained.
abstentions.wouldHaveBeen: separate object track for built-environment solar

abstentions.reason: The DSO Omgevingsdocumenten Downloaden API returned HTTP 401 'Inloggegevens ontbreken' (verified in the wind recon, A-06) — an API key is mandatory and none is available. The Gebied zonneveld GIO join-id is cited from the consolidated CVDR text (Bijlage II) only; geometry comes from the provincial agrest alias with provenance caveats.
abstentions.wouldHaveBeen: authoritative geometry for the FR-Z-02 zoneSelector

abstentions.reason: A major amendment is expected: PS vaststelling 18-11-2026, inwerkingtreding 01-01-2027 (verified in the wind recon, A-08). Its rules are NOT current law; the zon corpus must re-run the legal recon before that date.
